title: Cost to File Six Unfiled Nil Years
desc: Six unfiled nil years are six separate returns at $300.00 plus HST per tax year, so $1,800.00 in fees. The order they are filed in and what that does not cover.

title: What Is Not Included in the Nil T2 Fee
desc: The nil T2 fee covers one corporate return for one tax year. Registry annual returns, CO-17, AT1 and other CRA accounts sit outside it.
